gates.detail: Clean SMILES: FC(F)C(F)(F)OCC(F)(F)F

gates.title: Neutral & supported atoms
gates.threshold: Neutral molecule with supported atoms
gates.detail: Net charge 0, paired electrons, supported by mmff94s.

gates.title: Chiral centers labeled
gates.threshold: Every chiral center or E/Z bond is labeled
gates.detail: All stereocenters and double bonds are explicitly specified.

gates.title: 3D conformer generated
gates.threshold: At least 1 valid 3D shape
gates.detail: 3/3 initial shapes match 2D stereochemistry.

gates.title: No atom collisions
gates.threshold: Closest atoms >= 0.75 Å, zero non-bonded overlaps
gates.detail: All atoms have clear steric spacing.

gates.title: Realistic bond geometry
gates.threshold: Bond length within 0.30 Å of covalent radii
gates.detail: Checked 14 bonds and 25 bond angles.

gates.title: 3D chirality preserved
gates.threshold: 3D R/S and E/Z match input SMILES
gates.detail: SMILES perceived from 3D: FC(F)C(F)(F)OCC(F)(F)F

gates.title: Relaxed to low energy
gates.threshold: Max atom force <= 0.050 eV/Å
gates.detail: E = 3.7633 eV on MMFF94s (fast rule-based forces) (24 steps).

gates.title: 3D rotation & shift invariance
gates.threshold: Energy & rotated force diff < 1e-4; net force & torque < 1e-3
gates.detail: Rotated force diff 1.89e-14 eV/Å · net force 3.92e-16 eV/Å · net torque 4.55e-16 eV.

gates.title: Mirror symmetry & F = −∇E
gates.threshold: Mirror energy diff < 1e-4 eV & force-slope diff < 2e-3 eV/Å
gates.detail: Mirror ΔE = 0.00e+00 eV · mirror relation: correct (FC(F)C(F)(F)OCC(F)(F)F).

menthol.enantiomer_blindness_note: Mirror-twin molecules (enantiomers) have the exact same atom-to-atom distances, so their 3D energy difference is 0. Other wrong stereo shapes (diastereomers) change distances and show real energy differences.
